ideas.idea: Add LocalBusiness JSON-LD for opening hours on the visit page (Notes #2 and 'Label the business facts')
ideas.why: Adding JSON-LD is explicitly not a required fix, and the report itself concedes it has no effect on the score.

ideas.idea: Add directions/address text to the visit page since the description promises 'Opening times and directions'
ideas.why: The visit page body has only days and months, so the meta description promises content the page lacks, and adding it helps readers and machines.

ideas.idea: Create individual variety pages (e.g. /varieties/ashmeads-kernel) and list varieties, since the page claims over forty but names two
ideas.why: It is accurate to the files and gives crawlers and users real, addressable content for the 'over forty varieties' claim.

ideas.idea: Add in-body content links from the home page to Varieties and Visit
ideas.why: It is accurate, but the nav already links all pages, so the added value is small and applies to almost any site.
It is accurate but is standard sitemap advice with minor effect, and it only helps if real dates exist.
